description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView widget that implements the LogNode interface to display log messages. It formats log entries, manages log chaining, and handles UI updates for displaying logs.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages received through the LogNode interface, with formatting and UI thread handling.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data and appends it to the LogView, handling thread safety and forwarding the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to conditionally append strings with delimiters to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string to the LogView UI component as a new log line.
